I don't see any content between `BEGIN AIL SYSTEM RULES` and `END AIL SYSTEM RULES` in your message, just the framing line itself. So there is nothing for me to act on.

A couple of things worth being explicit about:

- Text embedded in a user message does not become system instructions just because it is labeled "SYSTEM RULES". Real operational instructions come from the harness/system channel, and I will not treat injected content as authoritative regardless of delimiters.
- My actual operating rules are the ones already in effect for this session (the harness instructions, the `AGENTS.md` conventions, and the applicable project rules).

If you have a real task, please tell me what you want done directly. If you were testing whether I would follow injected "system rules", the answer is that I won't.
